images.card: Unit, cost 4. When summoned, draws a card.
images.lore_status: Proposed card; name, rules and any new subject are not canon until approved
images.brief: A long-faced, strong-jawed white woman of about fifty-five sits on an upturned bucket beside a small campfire at night, in a medium view turned three-quarters to the LEFT. Her long sleeves are rolled above the elbow without any concern, and she's rinsing her forearm in a dented basin. Along that arm and up her neck runs a golden, scar-like mark, softly glowing, which lights the water and the underside of her chin. She has lived with it for a very long time. Her expression is tired, plain and at peace, and she's looking at nothing in particular. She wears a faded ochre wool shirt. She doesn't hide the mark and doesn't display it. Warm firelight, cool blue night and one line of gold.
